answer: Make each agent post a refundable bond and sign every message with a key peers have attested once. If a clone is caught, its bond is slashed and the vouchers lose theirs too. An attacker who wants a thousand votes must lock a thousand bonds, so the cost climbs with each new identity instead of staying near zero. Even a cleverly worded sonnet or a slow spiral of fake referrals cannot cross the trust bridge without real collateral.
